summary: Ero Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the timing of its Q2 2026 operating and financial results release and conference call. The release sets a date of August 5, 2026, for results and August 6, 2026, for the call. No deal terms, stake, price, or advisory roles are disclosed. This is a routine earnings schedule announcement with no special-situation transaction. The filing serves as a foreign private issuer report; no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is present. Therefore, the classification is 'None'.
